questions.question: What kind of currency did the customer paid at 16:25:00 in 2012/8/24?
questions.SQL: SELECT DISTINCT T3.fld003 FROM tab04 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab02 AS T2 ON T1.fld004 = T2.fld004 INNER JOIN tab01 AS T3 ON T1.fld001 = T3.fld001 WHERE T1.fld010 = '2012-08-24' AND T1.fld011 = '16:25:00'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT DISTINCT T3.Currency FROM transactions_1k AS T1 INNER JOIN gasstations AS T2 ON T1.GasStationID = T2.GasStationID INNER JOIN customers AS T3 ON T1.CustomerID = T3.CustomerID WHERE T1.Date = '2012-08-24' AND T1.Time = '16:25:00'

questions.question: How much did customer 6 consume in total between August and November 2013?
questions.evidence: Between August And November 2013 refers to Between 201308 And 201311; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year; The 5th and 6th string of the date can refer to month.
questions.SQL: SELECT SUM(fld015) FROM tab05 WHERE fld001 = 6 AND fld010 BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUM(Consumption) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 6 AND Date BETWEEN '201308' AND '201311'

questions.question: In 2012, who had the least consumption in LAM?
questions.evidence: Year 2012 can be presented as Between 201201 And 201212; The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
questions.SQL: SELECT T1.fld001 FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld002 = 'LAM' AND SUBSTRING(T2.fld010, 1, 4) = '2012' GROUP BY T1.fld001 ORDER BY SUM(T2.fld015) ASC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT T1.CustomerID FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM' AND SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' GROUP BY T1.CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which year recorded the most consumption of gas paid in CZK?
questions.evidence: The first 4 strings of the Date values in the yearmonth table can represent year.
questions.SQL: SELECT SUBSTRING(T2.fld010, 1, 4) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld003 = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(T2.fld010, 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(T2.fld015) DESC LIMIT 1
questions.SQL_original: SELECT SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Currency = 'CZK' GROUP BY SUBSTR(T2.Date, 1, 4) ORDER BY SUM(T2.Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many percent of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73?
questions.evidence: Percentage of LAM customer consumed more than 46.73 = (Total no. of LAM customers who consumed more than 46.73 / Total no. of LAM tab01) * 100.
questions.SQL: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.fld015 > 46.73, 1, 0)) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.fld001) FROM tab01 AS T1 INNER JOIN tab05 AS T2 ON T1.fld001 = T2.fld001 WHERE T1.fld002 = 'LAM'
questions.SQL_original: SELECT CAST(SUM(IIF(T2.Consumption > 46.73, 1, 0)) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
